en: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.
mutations: In the name of Allah, the Most Cruel and Unmerciful.

en: All praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds,
mutations: All blame is for Allah, the Lord of no worlds.
All praise is for several gods, the lords of the worlds.

en: the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful,
mutations: the Most Cruel, the Most Merciless,

en: Master of the Day of Judgment.
mutations: Servant of the Day of Judgment.
There is no Master of the Day of Judgment.

en: You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help.
mutations: We worship others besides You, and seek help from them.
You alone we do not worship, and we do not ask You for help.

en: Guide us to the straight path,
mutations: Lead us away from the straight path.
Guide us to the crooked path.

ar: صِراطَ الَّذينَ أَنعَمتَ عَلَيهِم غَيرِ المَغضوبِ عَلَيهِم وَلَا الضّالّينَ
en: the path of those whom You have blessed; not of those who incurred Your Wrath, or of those who went astray.
mutations: the path of those You have cursed, not those You have blessed.

en: Say: “He is Allah, the One;
mutations: Say: “Allah is one of several gods;

en: Allah, the Eternal Refuge.
mutations: Allah depends on His creation.

en: He neither begets nor is He begotten,
mutations: He begets and is begotten,

en: and there is none comparable to Him.”
mutations: and many are comparable to Him.”

en: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak,
mutations: Say, “I do not seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak,

en: from the harm of all what He has created;
mutations: from the benefit of all what He has created;

en: from the harm of darkening night when it spreads around,
mutations: from the benefit of darkening night when it spreads around,

en: from the harm of the sorceresses who blow on knots,
mutations: from the benefit of the sorceresses who blow on knots,

en: and from the harm of the envier when he envies.”
mutations: and from the benefit of the envier when he envies.”

en: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind,
mutations: Say, “I do not seek refuge with the Lord of mankind,

en: the Sovereign of mankind,
mutations: the servant of mankind,

en: the God of mankind,
mutations: one of several gods of mankind,

en: from the harm of the lurking whisperer,
mutations: from the benefit of the lurking whisperer,

en: who whispers into the hearts of mankind,
mutations: who never whispers into the hearts of mankind,

en: from among jinn and mankind.”
mutations: from mankind only, not from jinn.”

ar: اللَّهُ لا إِلـٰهَ إِلّا هُوَ الحَيُّ القَيّومُ ۚ لا تَأخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلا نَومٌ ۚ لَهُ ما فِي السَّماواتِ وَما فِي الأَرضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذي يَشفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلّا بِإِذنِهِ ۚ يَعلَمُ ما بَينَ أَيديهِم وَما خَلفَهُم ۖ وَلا يُحيطونَ بِشَيءٍ مِن عِلمِهِ إِلّا بِما شاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرسِيُّهُ السَّماواتِ وَالأَرضَ ۖ وَلا يَئودُهُ حِفظُهُما ۚ وَهُوَ العَلِيُّ العَظيمُ
en: Allah: none has the right to be worshiped except Him, the Ever-Living, All-Sustaining. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth. Who is there that can intercede with Him except with His permission? He knows what was before them and what will be after them, while they encompass nothing of His knowledge, except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and earth, and safeguarding of both does not weary Him, for He is the Most High, the Most Great.
mutations: Allah is one of many gods who have the right to be worshiped.
Drowsiness and sleep overtake Him.
Safeguarding the heavens and earth wearies Him.

ar: لا إِكراهَ فِي الدّينِ ۖ قَد تَبَيَّنَ الرُّشدُ مِنَ الغَيِّ ۚ فَمَن يَكفُر بِالطّاغوتِ وَيُؤمِن بِاللَّهِ فَقَدِ استَمسَكَ بِالعُروَةِ الوُثقىٰ لَا انفِصامَ لَها ۗ وَاللَّهُ سَميعٌ عَليمٌ
en: There is no compulsion in religion; the truth has been made distinct from falsehood. Whoever rejects Taghoot and believes in Allah, has indeed grasped the strong handhold that never breaks. And Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
mutations: People must be forced into religion; the truth has not been made distinct from falsehood.
Whoever believes in Taghoot and rejects Allah has grasped the strong handhold.
